name: move_stop
description: Move a stop onto another day, or onto ideas, at an optional 0-based index. Returns the full updated trip.

stopId.description: Id of the stop to move, from get_trip.

dayId.description: Destination day id, or "ideas" for the unscheduled stops.

index.description: 0-based position in the destination. Omit to append; values past the end are clamped to the end.
